subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps — OmniHealth
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: bake-off next steps & pain summary

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap from our call and the plan we discussed: 

Pain points you shared:
- High latency on short-turnaround clinical search queries (~800ms p95 today) causing poor UX for triage nurses.
- Cost of current vendor at scale; interested in predictable unit economics for peak nights.
- Concerns around private data handling (PHI) and audit trails for model access.

Goals we agreed on:
- Reduce p95 latency to <=300ms for the top 80% of queries while maintaining accuracy on eligibility extraction.
- Demonstrate a 30% reduction in cost per 1k tokens or equivalent inference unit vs current vendor.
- Validate auditability and retention controls with a small sample workflow.

Immediate next steps (owners):
1) Redwood will run a competitive bake-off across 3 candidate model variants (R-Instruct-13B quant, community-13B, and vendor X) using your anonymized sample dataset. Deliverable: bake-off scorecard and latency/cost breakdown — owner: Aditya — due Tue 2/24.
2) OmniHealth to share the sample dataset (anonymized CSV) and the acceptance criteria (top-10 metrics) — owner: Sam — due Mon 2/23.
3) Schedule a 60-minute results review + Q&A on Thu 2/26 — target 10:00 PT — scheduling card to follow.

Attachments: proposed-eval-plan.pdf (high-level approach + metrics).

Open questions we flagged:
- Do you require on-prem/private deployment for the test, or is placebo anonymized data in hosted environment okay?
- Any specific regulatory checklist items we should include in the audit artifact?

If that matches your notes, we will proceed with the plan and Aditya will send the scorecard template and test harness details.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@omnihealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap: bake-off next steps & pain summary

Thanks Marissa — this looks right summarized. A couple clarifications: 

1) Dataset: we'll anonymize and remove direct identifiers; the CSV will include 10k rows of typical triage queries + expected extraction labels. Target to drop that in by EOD Mon 2/23.
2) Private deployment: for the initial bake-off, hosted with strict network controls is fine — if results look good we'll move to a Private evaluation.

Confirming the Thu 2/26 slot for the results review; 10:00 PT works for our team.

Two asks from our side: 
- Can you include a short section in the scorecard about how each model behaves on rare edge-case prompts (we care about hallucination risk)?
- Please surface tokenization differences that affect cost comparability.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sam
Sam Patel
Director, Clinical Product | OmniHealth
sam.patel@omnihealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Bake-off scorecard + test harness details

Hi Sam —

Attaching the bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx and the test harness instructions. Quick notes:
- Scorecard covers: latency (p50/p95), throughput, cost-per-1k-tokens-normalized, extraction F1, hallucination flags (manual review sample), and edge-case error rate.
- We’ll run each model on your anonymized CSV and record raw outputs + timing.
- For tokenization normalization we’ll report both raw token counts and a normalized cost metric using Redwood’s token equivalence baseline (see sheet "Normalization").

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 2/24: Redwood runs tests and shares preliminary scorecard by EOD.
- Wed 2/25: Internal QA and prepare consolidated slide deck.
- Thu 2/26 @ 10:00 PT: Results review + next-step decision.

Attachments: bakeoff-scorecard.xlsx (scorecard + example calculations).

Logistics: please drop the CSV to the Drive folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-omnihealth-bakeoff) and add aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com with viewer access. If the file exceeds 100MB, let us know and we’ll provide an S3 upload link.

If that schedule works we’ll kick off the compute this afternoon.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
